mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact finite minus-one-root criterion at arithmetic primes, full finite lift fibers, and coefficient-valued C2 character restrictions under declared local finite quotient models, with reduction naturality and dyadic boundary checks.

bounds.arithmetic_depths: All m>=0 with p^m<=100000; every residue is scanned.
bounds.arithmetic_lift_fibers: Every consecutive depth pair in that range and every low root, testing all p digits independently.
bounds.boundary_checks: Arithmetic minus-one mod2 to mod4 obstruction; dyadic coefficient sign collision mod2 and separation mod4; coefficient 3mod8 does not lift to16.
bounds.coefficient_characters: Every residue candidate; independently test units and all four C2 group-law pairs.
bounds.local_restrictions: Every coefficient character at every coefficient level and every arithmetic prime in range.
bounds.naturality: Every ordered high>=low pair of levels within each coefficient prime, every high character, every arithmetic prime, both group values.

mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integer residue rings Z/(p^m); no floating-point arithmetic.
mathematics.conventions: Arithmetic variable y solves y^2=-1. Coefficient variable x solves x^2=+1 and is the image of the C2 generator. C2={0,1}, addition modulo two; modulus one is the zero ring. Local quotient model is zero for arithmetic p%4=1 and identity otherwise, including p=2.
inputs: All primes <=47 by independent trial-division enumeration.
non_claims: The finite local quotient map is a declared model and does not execute absolute Galois groups.
No universal prime splitting theorem, p-adic lift theorem, inertia identification, Hodge-Tate statement, Weil-Deligne attachment, or full arithmetic partial claim is established.
Finite lift fibers and naturality checks apply only within the stated bounds.
No external source-dependent implication or novelty claim is used.
